text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: For Falco to reach eveeeen higher heights as an umadol, I figured I need luck on my side too!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Besides, people have always said that show business and good fortune go hand in hand☆

text_block_list.name: Machikane Fukukitaru
text_block_list.text: I see, I see~ So that is why you came to consult with us!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: If that's what you need, leave it to us! Time to start our special good luck seminar♪

text_block_list.name: Machikane Fukukitaru
text_block_list.text: First and foremost, your fortune can change drastically just by changing the everyday accessories you handle!

text_block_list.name: Machikane Fukukitaru
text_block_list.text: For example, if you choose a good wallet, your financial fortune will dramatically improve!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Oho, oho☆

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: From a feng shui standpoint, the best thing to do is rearrange the interior of your room.

text_block_list.name: Machikane Fukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Behold, Lucky-kun, the bringer of good fortune! How about putting this on display?!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Sounds good! Though it is pretty huge.

text_block_list.name: Machikane Fukukitaru
text_block_list.text: True, it might be a bit too bulky. In that case, I also have a palm-sized daruma doll!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: That seems like it would fit nicely. And over here, putting up a large painting would be great.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: To keep it safe, let's go with—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Are you two holding back on me, by any chance? Are you thinking 'let's just start small'?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: If it's for the sake of being an umadol, Falco will take on anything! So please, give it your all!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Y-You're right... I was only thinking about what was easy to do, and ruled out the ultimate lucky methods...

text_block_list.name: Machikane Fukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Understood! Let us hit this with every ounce of power we have!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: An absolute must in feng shui is placing a mirror next to the entrance!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Mirror, check!

text_block_list.name: Machikane Fukukitaru
text_block_list.text: From smooth giant river stones to rainbow-glowing daruma dolls, behold my good fortune collection!!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Love it, love it~! Bring on whatever you've got!!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Let's add some houseplants!

text_block_list.name: Machikane Fukukitaru
text_block_list.text: A beckoning cat carved straight from a log!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: For this room, the bed needs to face east!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Alriiight, heaaave-ho!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And then—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Fa... Falcon-san? What is the meaning of this?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Rickey-chan and Fukukitaru-chan helped me boost my fortune!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I genuinely thought I had wandered into a bandit's hideout by mistake...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I decided I'll embrace anything if it helps me become a bigger umadol!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Um... Even if you can accept this, the room simply cannot.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: To begin with, there are far too many objects. It has completely exceeded the room's capacity.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I-I'm sure Flash-san's fortune will go up too, though!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: *sigh*... It cannot be helped. I will do what I can to keep what fits within reason.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Oh... Why, this is...! And here I thought I had lost it forever...!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: S-See, what did I tell you!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Even so, at a later date, Smart Falcon reportedly returned some of the good fortune charms.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: The dorm leader is going to scold you, you know?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: ! ...Ugh, alright...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Do not worry, I will help you clean up.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Smart Falcon and Eishin Flash's tidying-up reportedly escalated into a full-scale spring cleaning.
